label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee gathering for my forty years as mayor, in the great hall tomorrow at 18:00, coordinated with a lighting inspection and builder escort. Freight is arranging lanterns and 200 fresh loaves; the baker has supplied 32 and needs ingredients for 168 more. Freight was seeking the builder and innkeeper to coordinate, although the innkeeper's actual agreement is not confirmed. The secretary knowingly assists by reserving the appointment and relaying bread logistics. The surprise was initially undisclosed to me but the secretary has now revealed it.
